## Distance between samples

Based on `20260909`, the first pass results will be based on the pairwise sample distances, reported as the Mahalanobis distance with the Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage covariance estimator. The family-wise averages of the randomized dichotomy distances and the pairwise sample distances seem to be well correlated, so the overall results should be similarly reliable. 

## Reliable site distributions

@fig-corrs is a copy of the empirical CDFs and histograms of the split-half correlations for the sites, originally calculated in `20260826`. Previous results looked at the results for sites with correlations between 0.3 and 0.6. 

Split-half correlations in V1 and IT are similarly shaped, with a right-skewed distribution and a mode around $\rho \approx 0.1$. For V2, the correlations are left-skewed. V4 has a somewhat bimodal distribution, with a local peak around $\rho \approx 0.1$ and $\rho \approx 0.6$. 

```{r}
#| label: fig-corrs
#| fig-cap: "Empirical cumulative distribution functions (left) and histograms (right) for the split-half correlations by region. Data reflects split-half correlations performed when all blanks are averaged. V1 and IT are right-skewed, V2 is left-skewed, and V4 has a somewhat bimodal distribution for low- and high-correlations."
#| fig-width: 5.5
#| fig-height: 2.75
library(patchwork)
regions <- c("V1", "V2", "V4", "IT")
p_ecdf <- read.csv(here("results", "20260826", "split_corrs.csv")) %>%
  mutate(region = factor(region, levels = regions)) %>%
  filter(n_blanks == 1) %>%
  filter(grp_type == "img") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = corr, color = region)) + 
    stat_ecdf() + 
    labs(
      x = "Correlation", 
      y = "Empirical cumulative probability", 
      color = "Region") + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p_corrs_img <-  read.csv(here("results", "20260826", "split_corrs.csv")) %>%
  mutate(region = factor(region, levels = regions)) %>%
  filter(n_blanks == 1, grp_type == "img") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = corr, fill = region)) + 
    geom_histogram(aes(y = ..ncount..), bins = 15) + 
    labs(y = NULL, x = "Split-half correlation", fill = NULL) + 
    facet_wrap(vars(region)) + 
    theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "right")

p_ecdf + p_corrs_img + plot_layout(ncol = 2, widths = c(1, 1.2))
```

## Effect of reliability cutoffs

### V2 and V4 comparisons

Since previous results only selected sites with $\rho \in (0.3, 0.6)$, the highest reliability sites tend to be omitted. One sanity check is to make sure the relative results still hold even when taking a different reliability cutoff. 

Only V2 and V4 have more than 20 reliable sites with $\rho > 0.6$. 
 
```{r, eval = F}
regions <- c("V1", "V2", "V4", "IT")
read.csv(here("results", "20260826", "split_corrs.csv")) %>%
  mutate(region = factor(region, levels = regions)) %>%
  filter(grp_type == "img", n_blanks == 1) %>%
  mutate(matched = corr > 0.5 & corr < 0.7) %>%
  group_by(region) %>% 
  summarize(n_sites = sum(matched))
```

```{r}
set.seed(20260915)
source(here("R", "dM.R"))

# regions <- c("V1", "V2", "V4", "IT")
regions <- c("V2", "V4")
avgs <- qs_read(here(data_dir, "avgs.qs2"))
stimuli <- read.csv(here(data_dir, "stimuli.csv"))
n_sites <- 30

ps_params <- expand.grid(
  family = unique(stimuli$family), 
  coherence = c(1, 2),
  region = regions) %>%
  filter(family != 0) %>% # remove blanks
  mutate(region = as.character(region))
matched_sites <- read.csv(here("results", "20260826", "split_corrs.csv")) %>%
  filter(grp_type == "img", n_blanks == 1) %>%
  filter(corr > 0.6)

sites <- lapply(
  regions, 
  function(rgn) {
    site_ids <- matched_sites %>% 
      filter(region == rgn) %>% 
      .$site 
    sample(site_ids, n_sites, replace = F)})
names(sites) <- regions

v2_v4_ps <- lapply(
  cli_progress_along(1:nrow(ps_params)), 
  function(i) {
    fam <- ps_params[i, "family"]
    coherence <- ps_params[i, "coherence"]
    rgn <- ps_params[i, "region"]
    
    keep_idx <- (stimuli$coherence == coherence) & (stimuli$family == fam)
    img_grps <- stimuli[keep_idx, "id"]
    dat <- avgs[[rgn]][keep_idx, sites[[rgn]]]
    
    dM_pairwise(
      dat = dat, 
      grps = img_grps, 
      return_diff = F) %>%
      mutate(
        region = rgn, 
        family = fam, 
        coherence = ifelse(coherence == 1, "noisy", "natur")) }) %>%
  do.call(rbind, .)
```

```{r}
regions <- c("V2", "V4")
v2_v4_ps %>%
  mutate(region = factor(region, levels = regions)) %>%
  mutate(coherence = case_when(
    coherence == "natur" ~ "Naturalistic", 
    coherence == "noisy" ~ "Noisy")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(region, multi_d, fill = coherence)) + 
    geom_violin(trim = F, alpha = 0.5) + 
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white") + 
    facet_grid(cols = vars(coherence), scales = "free_y") +
    labs(
      x = NULL, 
      y = "Mahalanobis distance", 
      title = "High reliability between-sample distances", 
      fill = NULL) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none") + 
  scale_fill_discrete(palette = c(palette.colors()[3], palette.colors()[8]))
```
